title: Read a Small Dataset Without Overclaiming
purpose: Structured-data fixture for CSV ingestion, exact descriptive statistics, chart/table parity, axis integrity, correlation-versus-causation language, and synthetic-data provenance.

learner.audience: Beginning statistics learners using a small tabular dataset.

objectives.statement: Compute count, mean, median, minimum, maximum, and range exactly.
Build an honest labeled chart that preserves all ten observations.
criteria: Axis choice does not exaggerate differences

objectives.statement: Describe positive association without claiming causation.
criteria: States synthetic data cannot establish cause

sources.title: Descriptive analysis for the synthetic class-score dataset
sources.creator: Alystria fixture authors

claims.statement: The ten scores have mean 72, median 72.5, minimum 52, maximum 90, and range 38.
The synthetic observations show a positive association between study hours and score but cannot establish causation.

scenes.title: Inspect all ten rows
scenes.narration: The table contains ten synthetic students, study hours, and scores. No row represents a real person.
scenes.visualIntent: A sortable-looking but inert table preserves source order and marks the synthetic provenance.
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A three-column table exposes headers and all ten rows to assistive technology.

scenes.title: Compute descriptive statistics
scenes.narration: The scores sum to seven hundred twenty, so the mean is seventy-two. The middle pair, seventy-one and seventy-four, gives median seventy-two point five. The range is thirty-eight.
scenes.visualIntent: Exact arithmetic cards keep the source values visible beside each statistic.
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A labeled list gives each statistic, formula, and exact result.

scenes.title: See association, not cause
scenes.narration: Scores tend to rise with study hours in this synthetic table. The plot shows association, not proof that hours alone caused each score.
scenes.visualIntent: A scatter plot labels axes, shows all ten points, begins score context at a non-deceptive baseline, and has a text alternative.
scenes.captionText: Positive association in synthetic data—not causal proof
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A point-by-point table alternative lists study hours and score, followed by a qualified trend summary.

scenes.title: Describe, visualize, qualify
scenes.narration: Check the rows, compute exact summaries, visualize every observation, and state only the inference the data support.
scenes.visualIntent: A four-step concept thread connects table, arithmetic, chart, and qualification.
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A numbered recap lists the four analysis steps.

qualityAssertions.description: Computed values match exact expected summaries.
Table and chart contain all ten source observations with no invented row.
No narration or label claims that study hours caused scores.
Both axes are labeled and a complete text/table alternative exists.
Dataset is visibly marked synthetic and contains no personal data.

provenance.notes: Every record is synthetic and intentionally minimal for deterministic exact arithmetic.
